section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: The Rear View function will turn on under the following conditions:

li.p: Pressing the Parking/View button (1) while P (Park), N (Neutral) or D (Drive) and the vehicle speed is slower than 10 km/h (6 mph)

section.p: Pressing the View switching button (2) with the Rear top view on the screen allows you to select rear top view, rearview, or rear wide view.

section.title: Off conditions
section.p: The Rear View while driving function will turn off under the following conditions while parking:

li.p: Pressing the back button (3) on the rear monitor screen
Pressing the infotainment system operation button (4)
N (Neutral) or D (Drive) and the vehicle speed is faster than 10 km/h (6 mph)

note.p: Rear View will not turn off when the vehicle is in R (Reverse).
